title: Niagara Falls Open Air Cart Tour with Boat Cruise
includes: Photo stop near Table Rock and Horseshoe Falls
Scenic sightseeing along the Niagara Parkway
Admission to Niagara City Cruises boat cruise
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the stunning Niagara Falls in a unique and enjoyable way with the Niagara Open air cart tour. In just one hour, glide along the picturesque Niagara Parkway, taking in iconic sights like the Horseshoe Falls, Bridal Veil Falls, and historic landmarks such as the Niagara Parks Power Station. 

Your knowledgeable guide will share fascinating stories about the area's history and natural wonders. The adventure culminates with a thrilling boat cruise up close to the falls, making this tour perfect for anyone wanting to experience Niagara's highlights in comfort and style.
